title: Preserve authored brush and arpeggio timing
scope: Retain source brush duration and stroke kind/direction rather than replacing all durations with an eighth note.
acceptance: Use non-default brush durations and both directions, including the GPIF timing XProperty.
Document conversion between public note-value durations and source tick values, with exact boundary checks.
Independent GP8 consumption retains supported timing; inexpressible durations get a narrow report.
exclusions: Rasgueado finger patterns are a separate capability.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Preserves distinct Brush and Arpeggio kinds, both directions, exact GPIF tick timing, and imported absence.
Reports only compatibility conflicts and exact timings that GP8 cannot encode.
Contains typed kind, direction, note-value compatibility duration, and exact 960-PPQ timing.
Covers real GP3-7 fixtures, conversion boundaries, source absence, reconciliation, validation, exact wire output, reimport, and nonmutation.
Pinned AlphaTab retains the GP7 colors fixture's arpeggio kind, direction, and 117-tick timing after Go GP8 export.

Checked Brush/Arpeggio and both directions, exact XProperty timing including 117 ticks, legacy note-value conversion and edits, source absence, validation, fractional/overflow loss reports, and independent timing output. Fractional and out-of-int32 timing remains explicitly reported; rasgueado patterns are separate.

resolution: Added BeatStrokeKind plus BeatStroke.ExactDuration to preserve Brush versus Arpeggio and exact 960-PPQ timing while retaining Direction and note-value Duration compatibility. GP3-5 codes map to checked 30, 60, 120, 240, and 480 tick values. GPIF XProperty 687935489 preserves integral timing and source absence, coexists with beaming XProperties, and receives malformed, duplicate, orphan, and conflicting-kind diagnostics. Imported exact timing owns export until Duration is edited; an edited compatibility value wins conflicts, and clearing exact timing falls back without mutating the score. GP8 writes exact supported timing and reports only fractional or larger-than-int32 values narrowly. Focused real-fixture, wire, reimport, validation, read-only, authority, and pinned AlphaTab tests cover the contract. The structural probe retained the same 364-fixture set and changed exactly 19 brush comparisons: every added target fact is brushDuration, all affected comparisons now match their source, and no other capability comparison changed. Ten obsolete binary duration-normalization report groups and ten obsolete GPIF brush-XProperty diagnostics were removed.
